合規支援 ISO/IEC 27001:2022 與 42001:2023 | J: Compliance support: ISO/IEC 27001:2022 and 42001:2023 | Jason Tools Document Toolbox
ISO/IEC 27001:2022（資訊安全管理）與 ISO/IEC 4200: ISO/IEC 27001:2022 (information security management) and ISO/IEC 42001:2023 (AI management) certify an organization's management system, not software. This page lists the controls Jason Tools Document Toolbox (the tool) already provides, how an organization uses them, and where the records are kept, as a reference for building the management system and preparing audit evidence.
